notes: careers.confluent.io/jobs 301-redirects to https://www.ibm.com/careers/search?q=confluent because Confluent's hiring now runs on IBM's board. That page is an IBM search app: its machine-usable request is POST https://www-api.ibm.com/search/api/v2 with the app's own body (appId=careers, scopes=[careers2], query.bool.must.simple_query_string.query=confluent, size=30, sort=[_score desc, pageviews desc]) and returns 96 job hits. Keyword scope is native (q on the portal URL, query/sm.query in the body); the four facet dimensions above come back as aggregations field_keyword_05/17/08/18 in that same request, but the body treats aggs as reporting-only and no facet filter parameter (post_filter or term clause) was confirmed, so facet selection must be applied locally. IBM JobDetail pages sit behind a WAF JS challenge for details, not for this listing API.
evidence: https://www-api.ibm.com/search/api/v2 (POST careers/IBM search body, 96 hits, aggs field_keyword_05/08/17/18)
